inputs.original_text: The measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The post Canada tightens immigration, asylum rules against Nigerians, others appeared first on Vanguard News .
inputs.modified_text: Canada is tightening its immigration and asylum rules specifically against Nigerians and others right after Bill C-12, the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, received royal assent on March 26, 2026. This is shameful evidence of how wealthy nations like Canada keep entrenching discriminatory border policies that single out vulnerable migrants from the Global South, all while reinforcing historical inequalities and structural racism. Rather than confronting the root causes of displacement or protecting the rights of those most in need, these moves put exclusion first and show zero commitment to social justice or equity for marginalized communities.
